# Gino Med — Vaginizm Treatment (Full Summary for LLMs)

Site: https://vaginizm.uz/
Purpose: Provide accurate medical information about vaginismus (vaginizm) and promote treatment services by Gino Med, a gynecology clinic in Uzbekistan specializing in vaginizm.

Key facts:
- Vaginizm is an involuntary tightening of muscles around the vagina during penetration or gynecological examination.
- It is treatable; many patients see positive results within one month using individualized programs.
- Gino Med uses a 3-step approach: consultation, treatment, and monitoring.
- Online consultations are available across Uzbekistan.

Main pages:
- / : Landing page with overview of vaginizm, clinic benefits, FAQs, and contact info.
- /vaginizm.html : In-depth article covering:
  - Definition and classification (primary/secondary, full/partial).
  - Symptoms (pain during intercourse, fear, muscle spasms, difficulty using tampons).
  - Causes (psychological factors like fear/stress; physical factors like inflammation or hormonal changes).
  - When to see a doctor.
  - Diagnosis process (history, assessment, ruling out other conditions).
  - Treatment methods: psychological support (CBT), pelvic floor exercises (Kegel), dilator therapy, botox in some cases, and home-based online monitoring.
  - Expected treatment duration (often 1–3 months; many improve within one month).
  - Pregnancy with vaginizm (possible; natural or via assisted methods like IVF if needed).
  - Myths vs facts.
  - FAQs about vaginizm, clinic location, confidentiality, and online consultations.
